server_stderr_investigation.pattern: Every TCP_TLS run has exactly one such line, 55.1 to 58.9 s after reset release. The QUIC runs use a different server and have none.
server_stderr_investigation.last_publication_before_reset: seq 86 at 2026-11-10T15:02:28.440Z from the setup boot (server sensor CSV)
server_stderr_investigation.probable_cause: tcp_tls_server.py reads each client with a 60 s timeout and prints "TCP+TLS ERROR: {error}"; a timeout has an empty message. The setup-boot connection stopped sending at the reset, so its timeout would fall about 60 s later. This fits; unlogged data about 5 s after seq 86 would fit exactly.
server_stderr_investigation.status: Not proven. The line carries no connection identity. It is counted in connection_error_count as for HBPSN-04, 07 and 09, with no serial connection error, reboot, gap or shortfall in the run.
